exceptions.reason: `Switch` is one native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. A `Toolbar.Button` renders a `<button>`, and a button cannot hold an input.

The part writes `aria-orientation`, which the role `separator` takes, so CSS selects `[aria-orientation='vertical']` and the part writes no `data-orientation` (rule 8.15). The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).
A case of `ToolbarSeparator.test.tsx` tests the attributes of the developer, the template ref and the `element` slot. `Separator.test.ts` tests the rest of the element.
